title: Callvale after: three instances from one image
claim: Three right-sized instances start from one AMI and a launch template, and administrators connect through Session Manager with no inbound port.
alt: After: an AMI and a launch template supply three instances in the default VPC: a burstable web instance with an Elastic IP address, a compute optimized worker and a database instance. Administrators reach them through Session Manager; no inbound port is open.

edges.label: build once
edges.say: An AMI and a launch template describe the instance once.
The web, worker and database instances launch from that image.
Each instance gets a size that matches its work.
Administrators connect through Session Manager, so no inbound port is open.
The web instance keeps a fixed public address with an Elastic IP address.

notes: Brief 16 story pair, after; 2-deep.md#decision-record (after Decision). Title, claim, alt, steps from brief.json. Same cells as ec2-before and chapter 10's vpc-before: administrators A1, default VPC and subnet A3:B4, web A4, worker B3, database B4. The Elastic IP is a node (step 5 needs an arrow); Amazon S3 is left out (no step uses it). No load balancer, Auto Scaling group or RDS. Step facts in the Markdown per brief facts_for_steps. No AWS number in the drawing.
